name: @cafemenu/platform-functions
description: The platform project's backend: sets cafes up and runs their deploys, rollbacks and branding syncs with @cafemenu/deployer, as a worker on GitHub Actions (free) or as Cloud Functions (Blaze).

scripts.test:emulator: node scripts/copy-rules.mjs && npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:exec --config firebase.emulators.json --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-cafemenu "node --test tests/emulator/*.emulator.mjs"
scripts.test:worker: node scripts/copy-rules.mjs && npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:exec --config firebase.emulators.json --only auth,firestore --project demo-cafemenu "node --test tests/worker/*.emulator.mjs"
scripts.emulators: node scripts/copy-rules.mjs && npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:start --config firebase.emulators.json --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-cafemenu
scripts.deploy: node scripts/stage.mjs && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only functions
